label: reference
sql:
SELECT
            c.custkey,
            c.name,
            sum(
                l.extendedprice * (1 - l.discount)
            ) AS revenue,
            c.acctbal,
            n.name AS nation,
            c.address,
            c.phone,
            c.comment
        FROM tpch.sf1.customer AS c
        JOIN tpch.sf1.orders AS o
            ON c.custkey = o.custkey
        JOIN tpch.sf1.lineitem AS l
            ON l.orderkey = o.orderkey
        JOIN tpch.sf1.nation AS n
            ON c.nationkey = n.nationkey
        WHERE o.orderdate >= DATE '1993-10-01'
          AND o.orderdate < DATE '1994-01-01'
          AND l.returnflag = 'R'
        GROUP BY
            c.custkey,
            c.name,
            c.acctbal,
            n.name,
            c.address,
            c.phone,
            c.comment
        ORDER BY
            revenue DESC,
            c.custkey
        LIMIT 20

sql:

label: check_bronze_gzip
sql:
SELECT
            c.custkey,
            c.name,
            sum(
                l.extendedprice * (1 - l.discount)
            ) AS revenue,
            c.acctbal,
            n.name AS nation,
            c.address,
            c.phone,
            c.comment
        FROM lakehouse.bronze_gzip.customer AS c
        JOIN lakehouse.bronze_gzip.orders AS o
            ON c.custkey = o.custkey
        JOIN lakehouse.bronze_gzip.lineitem AS l
            ON l.orderkey = o.orderkey
        JOIN lakehouse.bronze_gzip.nation AS n
            ON c.nationkey = n.nationkey
        WHERE o.orderdate >= DATE '1993-10-01'
          AND o.orderdate < DATE '1994-01-01'
          AND l.returnflag = 'R'
        GROUP BY
            c.custkey,
            c.name,
            c.acctbal,
            n.name,
            c.address,
            c.phone,
            c.comment
        ORDER BY
            revenue DESC,
            c.custkey
        LIMIT 20

label: create_silver_schema
sql: CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS lakehouse.silver

label: create_gold_schema
sql: CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS lakehouse.gold

label: 04_silver_customers.sql
sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS
                    lakehouse.silver.customer_dim
                WITH (
                    format = 'PARQUET',
                    compression_codec = 'ZSTD'
                )
                AS
                SELECT
                    c.custkey,
                    c.name,
                    c.acctbal,
                    n.name AS nation,
                    c.address,
                    c.phone,
                    c.comment,
                    trim(c.name) AS name_normalized,
                    trim(c.address) AS address_normalized,
                    trim(c.comment) AS comment_normalized
                FROM lakehouse.bronze.customer AS c
                JOIN lakehouse.bronze.nation AS n
                    ON c.nationkey = n.nationkey
                WHERE c.custkey IS NOT NULL

label: 05_silver_returns.sql
sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS
                    lakehouse.silver.returned_lines
                WITH (
                    format = 'PARQUET',
                    compression_codec = 'ZSTD'
                )
                AS
                SELECT
                    o.custkey,
                    o.orderkey,
                    l.linenumber,
                    o.orderdate,
                    l.extendedprice,
                    l.discount,
                    l.extendedprice * (1 - l.discount) AS revenue
                FROM lakehouse.bronze.orders AS o
                JOIN lakehouse.bronze.lineitem AS l
                    ON l.orderkey = o.orderkey
                WHERE o.orderdate >= DATE '1993-10-01'
                  AND o.orderdate < DATE '1994-01-01'
                  AND upper(trim(l.returnflag)) = 'R'
                  AND l.extendedprice >= 0
                  AND l.discount BETWEEN 0 AND 1

label: 06_gold.sql
sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS
                    lakehouse.gold.returned_customers_top20
                WITH (
                    format = 'PARQUET',
                    compression_codec = 'ZSTD'
                )
                AS
                SELECT
                    c.custkey,
                    c.name,
                    sum(l.revenue) AS revenue,
                    c.acctbal,
                    c.nation,
                    c.address,
                    c.phone,
                    c.comment
                FROM lakehouse.silver.customer_dim AS c
                JOIN lakehouse.silver.returned_lines AS l
                    ON c.custkey = l.custkey
                GROUP BY
                    c.custkey,
                    c.name,
                    c.acctbal,
                    c.nation,
                    c.address,
                    c.phone,
                    c.comment
                ORDER BY
                    revenue DESC,
                    c.custkey
                LIMIT 20

                SELECT orderkey, linenumber

                GROUP BY orderkey, linenumber
                HAVING count(*) > 1
            )

            WHERE extendedprice IS NULL
